description: The Santa Rosa Roman Catholic Church is renowned for its close connection to the annual Santa Rosa Festival, one of the oldest indigenous celebrations in the Caribbean, which blends Catholic tradition with Amerindian heritage.The church's architecture, peaceful interior and longstanding role in community life make it both a spiritual centre and a cultural attraction. Listed opening hours: 9am - 5pm sat 9 to 12 noon. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
